_comment: Peapod's progression rules. These numbers were lifted verbatim from the original app so an existing pod's
level and Peanut balance mean exactly what they used to. This file is the single source of truth: the Rust
compute service embeds it at build time, the Node API reads it when awarding rewards, and the Expo app reads
it to render costs and thresholds. Never hardcode any of these values in a service -- change them here.
Design intent worth preserving: rewards are tied to real shared experiences, not to grinding. Completing an
actual trip together is worth 500 Peanuts while harvesting a plant is worth 8, which keeps the currency
anchored to life rather than to app usage.

gardenPlotCapacity._comment: Slots unlock with level: 2 + level*2, hard-capped at 12. The garden starts small and opens new ground as the pod grows. Capacity is never purchasable -- it always reflects real progression.

xpRewards._comment: XP granted per action. 'completeAchievement' is a fallback -- an achievement may carry its own xp value, which wins.

peanutEarnRules._comment: Peanuts granted per action, matching the original earn table.

startingBalances._comment: What a brand-new pod begins with. A new pod starts at zero XP with a bare garden; the demo seed pod in data/seed/ deliberately starts further along so every screen has something to show.

milestoneDays._comment: Day counts celebrated by the scheduled milestone job, measured from the pod's earliest pinned count-up date.
